entities.name: Josip Pliverić
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Josep Pliverić was a Croatian lawyer, university professor, theorist of the Croatian state law and a Member of Croatian Parliament. Pliverić was rector of the University of Zagreb in the academic years 1892/1893 and 1904/1905, a professor at the Faculty of Law, member of the Croatian Parliament from 1892 until 1906 and elected Croatian member of the Diet of Hungary in Budapest.
